bullets.text: Safe Browsing Innovations - **Microsoft Edge** introduces experimental agentic browsing features, enhancing user experience while addressing security risks.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New build 27975 released, featuring improvements for touch keyboard and Windows Hello functionality.
AI-Powered Copilot Mode - **Microsoft Edge** enhances browsing with Copilot Mode, streamlining tasks and improving user interaction.
Strengthening Identity Defense - **Microsoft** emphasizes the importance of comprehensive identity security in a hybrid work environment.
AI in Paint - New Restyle feature in **Paint** allows users to transform images with AI, now rolling out to Insiders.
Windows 11 Updates - Builds 26100.7015 and 26200.7015 released, featuring enhancements and fixes for user experience.
Cybersecurity Resilience - **Microsoft** highlights the evolving cyberthreat landscape and the need for strategic security adaptations.
Unified Security Solutions - **Microsoft Security Store** launched, offering a platform for trusted security solutions and AI agents.
Holiday Tech Gifting - **Microsoft** promotes innovative products for the holiday season, enhancing creativity and connectivity.
Azure SQL Migration Success - Organizations like **Thomson Reuters** modernize operations by migrating to **Azure SQL**, enhancing efficiency.
